```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))  # else cat() writes non-ASCII as <U+2010> under the C locale
library(dplyr); library(readr); library(knitr); library(here); library(stringr)
rd <- \(f) read_csv(here("data", "processed", f), show_col_types = FALSE)
engines <- rd("engines.csv") |> arrange(engine_name)
people  <- rd("people_roles_evidence.csv") |> filter(in_team)
pt      <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "patents_team.csv"),
                    col_types = cols(patent_id = col_character(), .default = col_guess()))
slug <- \(x) str_replace_all(str_to_lower(x), "[^a-z0-9]+", "-")
esc  <- htmltools::htmlEscape
```

US patents granted in 2021-2025 with an Engine team member among the inventors. A team member counts as
an inventor when the last name and the first name (or its start) match and the inventor's address is in the
Engine's states. Common names can still be namesakes: compare *Inventor as listed* with the person.
*In Engine profile* = a CPC code of the patent is in the Engine's technology profile (the grant's topic).
Choose an Engine, then click a name to open the list.

## Engines

```{r engines, results = "asis"}
cat('<select id="engine-select" class="form-control" style="width:auto; margin-bottom:15px">\n',
    paste0('<option value="', seq_len(nrow(engines)), '">', htmltools::htmlEscape(engines$engine_name), "</option>", collapse = "\n"),
    "\n</select>\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(engines))) {
  e  <- engines$engine_name[i]
  pe <- pt |> filter(engine_name == e)
  cat(sprintf('<div class="engine-pane" data-k="%d"%s>\n\n', i, if (i > 1) ' style="display:none"' else ""))
  cat(sprintf("[%s Engine page](%s.html). ", e, slug(e)))
  if (nrow(pe) == 0) {
    cat("No patents with a team member among the inventors were found.\n\n</div>\n\n")
    next
  }
  cat(sprintf("%d team members, %d patents (%d in the Engine's technology profile).\n\n",
              n_distinct(pe$person_id), n_distinct(pe$patent_id),
              n_distinct(pe$patent_id[pe$in_tech_profile])))
  ppl <- pe |> count(person_id, name, sort = TRUE)
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(ppl))) {
    p <- pe |> filter(person_id == ppl$person_id[j]) |> arrange(desc(grant_year), patent_id)
    tab <- tibble(Patent = paste0("US&nbsp;", p$patent_id),
                  Year = p$grant_year,
                  Title = esc(str_to_sentence(coalesce(p$title, ""))),
                  Assignee = esc(coalesce(p$assignees, "")),
                  `Inventor as listed` = esc(coalesce(p$inventor_as_listed, "")),
                  `In Engine profile` = if_else(p$in_tech_profile, paste0("yes (", p$cpc_matched, ")"), ""))
    cat(sprintf('<details id="patents-%s"><summary><b>%s</b>: %d %s (%d in Engine profile)</summary>\n\n',
                p$person_id[1], esc(p$name[1]), nrow(p), if (nrow(p) == 1) "patent" else "patents",
                sum(p$in_tech_profile)))
    print(kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"'))
    cat("\n</details>\n\n")
  }
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```

<script>
// Dropdown: show the chosen Engine's section
function showEngine(k) {
  document.getElementById("engine-select").value = k;
  document.querySelectorAll(".engine-pane").forEach(function (d) {
    d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-k") === String(k) ? "" : "none";
  });
}
document.getElementById("engine-select").addEventListener("change", function () { showEngine(this.value); });
// A link like patents.html#patents-<person_id> picks that Engine and opens that person's list
function openFromHash() {
  if (location.hash.indexOf("#patents-") !== 0) return;
  var d = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
  if (!d) return;
  var pane = d.closest(".engine-pane");
  if (pane) showEngine(pane.getAttribute("data-k"));
  d.open = true;
  setTimeout(function () { d.scrollIntoView(); }, 50);
}
window.addEventListener("load", function () { setTimeout(openFromHash, 0); });
window.addEventListener("hashchange", openFromHash);
</script>
